config.label: Postgres connection string the agent's queries run against
config.description: Postgres connection string the agent's queries run against. Give it a least-privilege role: Midplane constrains what SQL is allowed, it does not widen or narrow what the role itself can reach.

config.label: Path to a policy YAML granting per-table read/read_write access, tenant scoping, and column masking
config.description: Path to a policy YAML granting per-table read/read_write access, tenant scoping, and column masking. Omit for the safe default: reads allowed, writes and DDL denied. Generate one with `npx midplane init`.

config.label: Where the local SQLite audit log is written
config.description: Where the local SQLite audit log is written. Defaults to ~/.midplane/audit.db; read it back with `midplane audit denies`.

config.label: Set to 0 to disable anonymous usage telemetry (DO_NOT_TRACK=1 also works)
config.description: Set to 0 to disable anonymous usage telemetry (DO_NOT_TRACK=1 also works). Never includes SQL, table or column names, or identifiers.
